svg.font-family: system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: J — Lush premium mobile · Thrills & Chills round-3 art concept
svg.text: Rich, saturated and polished: a lake with foam and a sandy
rim, rock-sided hill, glossy clustered foliage, flowerbeds,
kerb-stone paths, soft ambient occlusion, gentle gradients.

g.text: Gradients on every face; gloss on every ball.
Shore = halo + foam band + sand rim.
Paths: kerb band, paving joints, warm fill.
